rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for exceptionally fine food, objects, or delicate workmanship, and for something delicate or exact.

example.english: This handmade ceramic piece is exquisite.
example.traditional: 呢件手工陶瓷做得好精緻。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 sau2 gung1 tou4 ci4 zou6 dak1 hou2 zing1 zi3

rows.note: Use this for pain, pleasure, or another feeling that is exceptionally intense.

example.english: I was in exquisite pain from this toothache and couldn't sleep all night.
example.traditional: 呢種牙痛好強烈，我成晚都瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 ngaa4 tung3 hou2 koeng4 lit6 ngo5 sing4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this when exquisite means demanding high standards or being particular about taste and quality.

example.english: My mother has exquisite standards for ingredients and will not buy anything that is not fresh.
example.traditional: 我阿媽對食材好講究，唔新鮮嘅一律唔買。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 deoi3 sik6 coi4 hou2 gong2 gau3 m4 san1 sin1 ge3 jat1 leot6 m4 maai5
